issue.standard_remedy: Map the sub-tier and qualify an alternate
issue.summary: Depends on a single-source sub-tier supplier (Europe)

plan.diagnosis: Yukon Pacific Packaging GmbH is a single-source supplier with USD 1,109,178 in annual spend that depends on 42 sub-tier suppliers, creating hidden dependency risk despite a high resiliency score of 92. While the supplier is based in Germany (low geo-risk Europe) with zero disruption events in the past 12 months, the single-source relationship and unknown sub-tier concentration expose the organization to potential supply chain interruptions worth the full USD 1.1M spend.

remedy_steps.step: Conduct sub-tier mapping exercise with Yukon Pacific Packaging GmbH to identify critical dependencies among their 42 sub-tier suppliers, prioritizing those supporting >15% of our USD 1.1M spend
Issue RFI to 3-4 alternative packaging suppliers in Europe with comparable capabilities to establish technical qualification baseline and pricing benchmarks against current USD 1.1M spend
Negotiate sub-tier transparency clause and business continuity commitments into renewed contract with Yukon Pacific Packaging, requiring quarterly sub-tier risk reporting
Qualify and onboard one alternate supplier across all ERPs (SAP, Oracle EBS, Dynamics 365, NetSuite, Coupa) for 20-30% of volume to establish dual-source capability
remedy_steps.owner: Supplier Quality Engineer & ERP Master Data team

remedy_steps.step: Execute trial orders worth USD 220,000-330,000 (20-30% of annual spend) with qualified alternate supplier and validate performance against quality and delivery KPIs

plan.expected_impact: Mitigate single-source risk on USD 1,109,178 annual spend and establish dual-source resilience to protect against sub-tier disruptions; potential 5-8% cost reduction (USD 55,000-89,000) through competitive pressure.
kpis: Sub-tier visibility: Map 100% of critical sub-tier suppliers (target 8-10 suppliers representing 80% of Yukon's input cost)
Dual-source achievement: Establish qualified alternate supplier covering 20-30% of USD 1.1M spend within 120 days
Supply continuity: Maintain zero disruption events while transitioning to dual-source model
Cost competitiveness: Benchmark alternate supplier pricing within 5% of current USD 1.1M baseline
risks: Yukon Pacific Packaging may resist sub-tier transparency due to competitive concerns, delaying mapping by 30-45 days
Limited alternate supplier availability in Europe packaging market may reduce negotiating leverage and extend qualification timeline
Splitting volume 70/30 between suppliers may reduce economies of scale and increase unit costs by 3-5% (USD 33,000-55,000)
Multi-ERP environment complexity may delay alternate supplier onboarding and create master data inconsistencies across SAP, Oracle, Dynamics, NetSuite, and Coupa
erp_actions: SAP: Create source list entries (ME01) for new alternate supplier with 20-30% quota arrangement; maintain Yukon as preferred source at 70-80%
SAP: Add sub-tier risk flag in vendor master (LFA1 custom field) and enable quarterly review workflow
Oracle EBS: Set up approved supplier list (ASL) with dual sources and configure sourcing rules for automatic allocation
Dynamics 365: Create vendor master record for alternate supplier with payment terms matching Yukon (Net 60 assumed) and assign to packaging commodity code
NetSuite: Configure vendor records with sub-tier risk classification and enable spend tracking by supplier for the USD 1.1M baseline
Coupa: Update sourcing policy to require dual-source for packaging category spend >USD 1M annually; configure approval workflow for single-source POs exceeding USD 50K
All ERPs: Implement common vendor classification code 'SINGLE_SOURCE_MITIGATION' to track remedy progress across systems
